SUBJECT: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | DATE: 15 Jan 2025 | DEPT: Imaging
Clinical Context:
Follow-up assessment for established prostate malignancy. Current PSA registers at 8.7 ng/mL. Previous imaging identified a PI-RADS 4 anomaly.
FINDINGS:
Glandular volume measures 35.27 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a discrete hypointense focus, roughly 14 x 12 mm, situated in the right mid-peripheral zone. This area shows intense restricted diffusion on DWI, mirrored by reduced ADC signal. DCE sequences demonstrate prompt, localized enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. Capsular integrity remains intact without extraprostatic spread or seminal vesicle involvement. Neurovascular bundles are unremarkable. Pelvic lymph nodes show no pathological features.
IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right mid-peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 35.27 mL; PSA density 0.247 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.82454866.

previous_notes.text: During a routine wellness visit on 30 Jul 2023, laboratory screening returned a PSA level of 5.2 ng/mL, slightly above the expected range for his demographic. This result prompted a urology outpatient referral, with instructions to schedule the consultation and transport earlier imaging documentation.
